claims.claim: The proposal requests ₳18,263,496.00, stated as USD $4,565,874.00, for three Cardano core infrastructure work packages over 2026-2027.
The proposer states Peras v1 remains undeployed on mainnet and needs production cryptography, operational tooling, and Hard Fork readiness work before mainnet delivery.
The proposer claims Peras would provide faster finality of about 2 minutes compared with about 12 minutes today.

The proposer claims Leios-driven throughput could cause SPO disk usage to surge to about 1 GB per hour at 100-1000 TPS, making full-history requirements economically prohibitive without History Expiry.
The proposer states the three work packages are interdependent and should be treated as a single delivery pipeline because separating them would increase delivery risk.
The budget is said to be based on a $176 per hour average market rate for senior Cardano infrastructure engineers and an ADA/USD conversion rate of 0.25 based on a five-year average.

The proposal says Intersect will administer contracts and audits using milestone-based fixed price contracts where scope is well-defined, with a legal contract between Tweag and Cardano Development Holdings.
The proposer states technical deliverables will undergo mandatory IOG code review and independent validation by No Witness Labs as a third-party assessor.

The proposal identifies an on-chain treasury reserve stake address, a prior validation transaction hash, and permissions for TRSC and PSSC administration with Intersect and external oversight entities.

The proposer states all undisbursed funds at the end of the delivery period, and unspent funds from partial delivery or scope reduction, will be returned to the Cardano Treasury with final reconciliation reporting.

summary: The document requests ₳18.26M for Tweag core infrastructure work administered by Intersect, with broad technical, governance, oversight, refund, and community reporting commitments, but detailed budget, feasibility, alternatives, failure-mode, and community-impact analysis are not included in the supplied anchor text.
